name: laserfiche-mcp
description: Search and read documents in a self-hosted Laserfiche repository from Claude — no terminal or JSON editing required.
long_description: Connects Claude to a self-hosted Laserfiche Repository API Server. Fill in your repository URL and service-account credentials in the settings form below and click Save — Claude can then search the repository, list folders, look up entries, read template field values, and extract document text. Ships read-only by default; the write surface stays disabled unless you turn off Read-only mode. Community project, not affiliated with Laserfiche.

tools.name: laserfiche_search
tools.description: Search the repository with native Laserfiche syntax

tools.name: laserfiche_search_natural
tools.description: Guided natural-language search (templates first, then executes)

tools.name: laserfiche_folder_list
tools.description: List the contents of a folder

tools.name: laserfiche_entry_get
tools.description: Look up a single entry by ID

tools.name: laserfiche_entry_get_by_path
tools.description: Resolve a repository path to an entry

tools.name: laserfiche_field_values_get
tools.description: Read all template field values on an entry

tools.name: laserfiche_document_edoc_get
tools.description: Read document metadata, bytes, or extracted text

repo_api_url.title: Repository API URL
repo_api_url.description: Base URL of your Laserfiche Repository API Server, with no trailing path. Example: https://lf.example.com/LFRepositoryAPI

repository_id.title: Repository name
repository_id.description: The repository name or ID — the same one you pick in the Web Access client login.

username.title: Service account username
username.description: A Laserfiche service account with read access to the repository.

password.title: Service account password
password.description: Stored securely in your operating system's keychain — never written to a plaintext config file.

api_version.title: API version
api_version.description: Which Repository API surface your server exposes: type v1 (most current on-prem installations) or v2 (newer builds). If unsure, leave v1.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Recommended. When on, Claude can search and read but can never create, change, or delete anything. Turn off only after reading the Safety model in the README.

verify_ssl.title: Verify TLS certificate
verify_ssl.description: Leave on for production. Turn off only for a dev server with a self-signed certificate.
